# An accessory (inputs/tri.x) and a WAV (inputs/tone.wav): accessory values,
# parent, keys, copy and paste, and the PMM save.
load model chain8.pmx
load accessory .\tri.x
load wav tone.wav
select camera
select accessory tri.x
frame 0
accessory position 1 2 3
accessory rotation 10 20 30
accessory scale 2
accessory opacity 0.5
register accessory
frame 20
accessory parent chain8 頭
accessory position 0 1 0
register accessory
save pmm registered.pmm

select all accessory
copy
frame 40
paste
save pmm pasted.pmm

select all accessory
frame 41
delete
save pmm accessory.pmm
